description: Notifications and attention (D03): native actions, truthful status, singleton ownership, retention and themes.

cases.vm_check: Select SwayNC; toggle DND from the bar or action_exec.sh notifications.dnd.toggle; send notify-send -u normal and -u critical: only the critical popup appears; status_read.sh notifications shows dnd true
Send three notifications, run action_exec.sh notifications.dismiss.all: all popups disappear; the control center still lists them
Run action_exec.sh notifications.history.open: the control center opens and lists earlier notifications
Run action_exec.sh notifications.center.toggle twice: the control center opens and closes
With the provider stopped, status_read.sh notifications reports running false and no daemon starts; with it running, counts and DND match what is on screen; no notification text appears in the JSON
With SwayNC selected and another notification daemon already running, log in: role_exec.sh refuses to start SwayNC (exit 10, logged in notifications.log) and the other daemon keeps running
Not applicable for a pass: SwayNC has no native cap or expiry; confirm the limitation text in the installer
cases.limits: No provider supports 24-hour expiry natively; the option stays limited.

cases.vm_check: Lock with hyprlock (Super+L), send notify-send -u critical from another TTY or ssh: no popup or text is visible on the lock screen; unlock and the notification is handled normally
cases.limits: Lock rendering cannot run headless; ext-session-lock-v1 and the absent above_lock/session_lock_xray settings are the only local evidence.

cases.vm_check: Send notify-send -e 'transient'; after it closes it is not in the SwayNC history
